title: 策略师谢毅哲：企业调研显示成本控制，等待消费回暖
speaker: Unnamed Guest

segments.en: Well, I think it's still the innovations, the cost-efficiency of a lot of these manufacturing firms in China, which when I, two weeks ago, I went and visited a few of the companies.
segments.zh: 嗯，我认为仍然是创新，以及中国许多制造企业的成本效率，两周前我走访了几家公司。

segments.en: They basically obviously the share price is not too well. And they're very cautious in terms of cost control. Because of the evolution, they're very cautious of how to, on one hand, control costs to give you nice margins.
segments.zh: 它们股价显然不太好。它们在成本控制方面非常谨慎。由于演变，它们非常谨慎地一方面控制成本以提供良好利润率。

segments.en: On the other hand, they're also very active in shareholder management by back and all that. So I think I am seeing a meeting with a group of corporates.
segments.zh: 另一方面，它们也非常积极地通过回购等进行股东管理。所以我认为我看到了与一群企业的会面。

segments.en: They really cautious of what the market is expecting, and they are trying their best to deliver. So in the current difficult market, yes, you might write off them.
segments.zh: 它们非常谨慎地关注市场预期，并尽力实现。所以在当前困难的市场中，是的，你可能会看淡它们。

segments.en: But eventually, when the market come back, like consumption eventually come back, they would fly because they already done what they need to in terms of managing the company.
segments.zh: 但最终，当市场回暖，比如消费最终回暖，它们会腾飞，因为它们在管理公司方面已经做了该做的。
